rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose noun for a desktop computer.

example.english: My desktop is broken, so I can't get any work done today.
example.traditional: 我部枱機壞咗，今日做唔到嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 toi4 gei1 waai6 zo2 gam1 jat6 zou6 m4 dou2 je5

rows.note: Use this in a computing context for the operating system's main screen workspace.

example.english: Put the files back on the desktop, and they'll be easier to find.
example.traditional: 你將啲檔案放返喺桌面，咁就易搵喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 di1 dong2 on3 fong3 faan1 hai2 zoek3 min6 gam2 zau6 ji6 wan2 laa3
